verses.restored: Then the reign of the heavens will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.

familiar.text: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.

verses.restored: Five of them were foolish and five wise.

familiar.text: And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.

verses.restored: The foolish took their lamps but did not take oil with them.

familiar.text: They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:

verses.restored: The wise took oil in vessels with their lamps.

familiar.text: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.

verses.restored: As the bridegroom delayed, they all became drowsy and slept.

familiar.text: While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.

verses.restored: At midnight there was a cry: Look, the bridegroom! Come out to meet him.

familiar.text: And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.

verses.restored: Then all those virgins rose and trimmed their lamps.

familiar.text: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.

verses.restored: The foolish said to the wise, Give us some of your oil, because our lamps are going out.

familiar.text: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.

verses.restored: The wise answered, Perhaps there will not be enough for us and you; go rather to the sellers and buy for yourselves.

familiar.text: But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.

verses.restored: While they were going away to buy, the bridegroom came; those ready went in with him to the wedding feast, and the door was shut.

familiar.text: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.

verses.restored: Later the other virgins came also, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.

familiar.text: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.

verses.restored: But he answered, Amen, I say to you: I do not know you.

familiar.text: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.

verses.restored: Therefore keep watch, because you know neither the day nor the hour.

familiar.text: Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.

verses.restored: For it is like a man going away who called his own servants and handed over his possessions to them.

familiar.text: For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country, who called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.

verses.restored: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, each according to his own ability; and he went away.

familiar.text: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and straightway took his journey.

verses.restored: Immediately the one receiving five talents went and worked with them and gained five more.

familiar.text: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made them other five talents.

verses.restored: Likewise the one with two gained two more.

familiar.text: And likewise he that had received two, he also gained other two.

verses.restored: But the one receiving one went away, dug in the ground, and hid his lord's silver.

familiar.text: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord’s money.

verses.restored: After much time, the lord of those servants came and settled account with them.

familiar.text: After a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and reckoneth with them.

verses.restored: The one receiving five talents brought five more, saying, Lord, you handed me five talents; look, I gained five more.

familiar.text: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.

verses.restored: His lord said to him, Well done, good and faithful servant. You were faithful over a few things; I will appoint you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.

familiar.text: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

verses.restored: The one with two talents also came, saying, Lord, you handed me two talents; look, I gained two more.

familiar.text: He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents beside them.

verses.restored: His lord said to him, Well done, good and faithful servant. You were faithful over a few things; I will appoint you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.

familiar.text: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

verses.restored: The one having received one talent came and said, Lord, I knew you to be a hard man, reaping where you did not sow and gathering where you did not scatter.

familiar.text: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed:

verses.restored: Being afraid, I went and hid your talent in the ground. Look, you have what is yours.

familiar.text: And I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, there thou hast that is thine.

verses.restored: His lord answered, Harmful and lazy servant, you knew that I reap where I did not sow and gather where I did not scatter?

familiar.text: His lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:

verses.restored: Then you should have placed my silver with the bankers, and coming I would have received what was mine with interest.

familiar.text: Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and then at my coming I should have received mine own with usury.

verses.restored: Therefore take the talent from him and give it to the one having ten talents.

familiar.text: Take therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him which hath ten talents.

verses.restored: For to everyone having, more will be given and he will overflow; but from the one not having, even what he has will be taken.

familiar.text: For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath.

verses.restored: Cast the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness; there will be weeping and grinding of teeth.

familiar.text: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

verses.restored: When the Son of Humanity comes in his glory, and all the messengers with him, then he will sit on his throne of glory.

familiar.text: When the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:

verses.restored: All the nations will be gathered before him, and he will separate them from one another as the shepherd separates sheep from goats.

familiar.text: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats:

verses.restored: He will set the sheep on his right and the goats on his left.

familiar.text: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.

verses.restored: Then the King will say to those on his right, Come, blessed of my Father, inherit the reign prepared for you from the foundation of the world.

familiar.text: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:

verses.restored: For I was hungry and you gave me food; I was thirsty and you gave me drink; I was a stranger and you gathered me in;

familiar.text: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in:

verses.restored: naked and you clothed me; sick and you visited me; in prison and you came to me.

familiar.text: Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me.

verses.restored: Then the righteous will answer, Lord, when did we see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give drink?

familiar.text: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, and fed thee? or thirsty, and gave thee drink?

verses.restored: When did we see you a stranger and gather you in, or naked and clothe you?

familiar.text: When saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee?

verses.restored: When did we see you sick or in prison and come to you?

familiar.text: Or when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee?

verses.restored: The King will answer, Amen, I say to you: as much as you did it to one of the least of these my brothers and sisters, you did it to me.

familiar.text: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.

verses.restored: Then he will say to those on the left, Depart from me, cursed ones, into the age-long fire prepared for the adversarial one and his messengers.

familiar.text: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:

verses.restored: For I was hungry and you did not give me food; I was thirsty and you did not give me drink;

familiar.text: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink:

verses.restored: I was a stranger and you did not gather me in; naked and you did not clothe me; sick and in prison and you did not visit me.

familiar.text: I was a stranger, and ye took me not in: naked, and ye clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.

verses.restored: Then they also will answer, Lord, when did we see you hungry, thirsty, a stranger, naked, sick, or in prison, and did not serve you?

familiar.text: Then shall they also answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?

verses.restored: Then he will answer, Amen, I say to you: as much as you did not do it to one of the least of these, neither did you do it to me.

familiar.text: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these, ye did it not to me.

verses.restored: These will go away into age-long correction, but the righteous into age-long life.

familiar.text: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.
